races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Cristo
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist for in-form Hannon yard, suits the likely strong pace but 23 days off could blunt his finishing kick

runners_data.name: Sweet Reward
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 9-year-old's experience, apprentice jockey takes 5lbs off but faces traffic dangers in crowded forward positions

runners_data.name: Towerlands
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse coming back from 36-day break, has winning form at the trip but needs the race to develop properly

runners_data.name: Twisting Physics
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from cold Oliver Cole yard (0/6 last 14 days), drops back from recent good form at shorter trips

runners_data.name: Salamanca City
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with solid recent form, perfectly positioned if Noble Horizon creates honest fractions from the front

runners_data.name: Noble Horizon
runners_data.note: Only natural leader after 210-day absence, will dictate terms but long break is a major concern for stamina

runners_data.name: Morcar
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with headgear applied, part of strong Hannon team but last run was a non-finish

runners_data.name: Youthful King
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has been disappointing over longer trips recently, needs significant pace improvement to feature

runners_data.name: Double Red
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with recent winning form at this distance, well-placed if the race develops into tactical affair

runners_data.name: Warning Sign
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying bottom weight with 7lb claim, but trainer yard struggling for winners lately

races.paceDynamic: Noble Horizon is the only natural front-runner in this field and will dictate proceedings from the start without serious early pressure. Sweet Reward, Twisting Physics, Morcar and Warning Sign all want prominent positions, creating a cluster 2-3 lengths behind Noble Horizon that could lead to traffic problems turning for home. The single leader should maintain a steady, uncontested gallop through the middle sections before the prominent group and hold-up horses (Cristo, Towerlands, Salamanca City, Double Red) launch their challenges. This pace setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can avoid the prominent congestion and benefit from the solid gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Noble Horizon sets honest fractions and the prominent group gets crowded
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader creates perfect conditions for closers to pick up the pieces while prominent runners struggle for racing room in the straight. Hold-up specialists Cristo, Towerlands, Salamanca City and Double Red get clear runs to exploit.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Noble Horizon Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and Noble Horizon kicks clear early in the straight
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it and has enough left to repel late challenges on the testing ground. Prominent runners can't get to him from their secondary positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners bunch up and interfere with each other's runs
scenarios.body: Sweet Reward, Twisting Physics, Morcar and Warning Sign compromise each other through overcrowding, allowing an outsider to sneak through. The pace collapses become messy and unpredictable.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Noble Horizon goes too slow early and gets swamped by the prominent group
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a sprint finish where the prominent runners overwhelm the leader before the closers can get involved. Track position becomes crucial in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Noble Horizon's fitness after 210 days off - if he weakens badly in the final furlong the race opens right up
Traffic problems in the prominent group between Sweet Reward, Twisting Physics, Morcar and Warning Sign turning for home
Cristo's sharpness after 23-day break when the pace could set up perfectly for his finishing kick
Towerlands' jumping from the gates after his 36-day layoff - needs to be handy enough to capitalize on the likely pace
Sweet Reward and Warning Sign's 5lb and 7lb apprentice claims becoming crucial if the finish gets tight

races.name: William Hill Oaks Trial Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)

runners_data.name: Romantic Symphony
runners_data.note: Perfect form line with two wins suggests she's improving and handles this going well based on similar conditions success.

runners_data.name: Bloom
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who can control the tempo but may face more pressure than usual from the prominent group behind.

runners_data.name: Amora Queen
runners_data.note: Strong recent second suggests she's in good heart and her mixed distance form shows versatility for this trip.

runners_data.name: Prizeland
runners_data.note: Hold-up style gives her a different tactical angle but she needs the pace to be strong enough to set up her closing kick.

runners_data.name: Cameo
runners_data.note: Inconsistent recent form is concerning despite the class of Ryan Moore and Aidan O'Brien combination.

races.paceDynamic: Bloom will likely lead from the start with Romantic Symphony, Amora Queen, and Cameo all keen to sit prominent in the early stages. This creates a substantial front group of four runners all wanting similar positions, which should ensure a solid tempo throughout the 1m3½f journey. Prizeland as the sole hold-up runner will track from the rear but faces the challenge of making up significant ground. The bunched prominent group and sustained pace strongly favours front-running and prominent racers who can secure good positions early and kick from there.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bloom Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Bloom can dictate fractions without serious early pressure from the prominent trio.
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets an easy lead and can control the race, kicking clear when the others come to challenge. Front-runners with tactical speed benefit most when they're not bustled early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royale
scenarios.trigger: If Romantic Symphony, Amora Queen and Cameo all race keenly trying to get closer to Bloom.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes strong with four horses all racing prominently, setting up a grueling test of stamina and class. Those with the best recent form and tactical pace will prevail in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closing Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet goes too hard early and Prizeland gets the right split at the right time.
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable and the hold-up runner sweeps past tiring leaders in the final furlong. Only works if Prizeland has enough class and the splits appear.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Cameo Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Cameo settles better than usual and Ryan Moore times his challenge perfectly.
scenarios.body: The Ballydoyle filly uses her class advantage to quicken past the others when it matters, despite her inconsistent recent form. Needs everything to fall right given her recent struggles.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Bloom gets an uncontested lead as she could prove very hard to peg back with a clear tactical advantage.
Monitor how keenly Romantic Symphony and Amora Queen travel in the early stages as both can race enthusiastically.
Check Prizeland's position turning for home as she needs to be within striking distance to make her hold-up style effective.
Observe Cameo's early settling as her recent keen racing has been problematic and she needs to relax to show her best.
Watch the pace through the middle stages as this prominent-heavy field could create an unsustainable gallop.

races.name: William Hill Lingfield Derby Trial Stakes (Listed Race) (Colts & Geldings)

runners_data.name: Maltese Cross
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to expected strong pace, with Tom Marquand's tactical awareness a major asset in small field

runners_data.name: Isaac Newton
runners_data.note: Ryan Moore's presence significant for Ballydoyle runner whose hold-up style should benefit from anticipated gallop despite recent disappointments

runners_data.name: Maho Bay
runners_data.note: Unbeaten leader whose front-running style could be compromised by Balzac and A Taste Of Glory, but has shown tactical flexibility

runners_data.name: Bay Of Brilliance
runners_data.note: 194-day absence is major concern despite early-season wins, needs others to set it up from prominent position

runners_data.name: Balzac
runners_data.note: Recent fitness advantage from 11-day gap could prove decisive if he can get first run on his front-running rivals

runners_data.name: A Taste Of Glory
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated leader whose best chance relies on others going too fast, but track experience gives him tactical knowledge

races.paceDynamic: Maho Bay, Balzac, and A Taste Of Glory will ensure a strong early gallop in this small but competitive field. With three confirmed front-runners all likely to press forward, the pace will be honest throughout the extended 1m3½f trip. The sustained tempo will test stamina reserves in the final three furlongs, particularly on Lingfield's testing climb to the line. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can conserve energy and produce late kicks when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too hard early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The strong pace will set up perfectly for Maltese Cross and Isaac Newton to storm home late when the leaders tire. Both hold-up performers have the class and tactical speed to capitalize when the race falls apart in front of them.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Maho Bay Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Maho Bay can dictate a more measured pace from the front
scenarios.body: The unbeaten Godolphin runner can use his tactical speed to kick clear when it matters most. His proven ability at this trip and excellent recent form makes him dangerous if allowed to control the race on his own terms.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Balzac Gets First Run
scenarios.trigger: If Balzac can steal a march on his rivals turning for home
scenarios.body: The Jane Chapple-Hyam runner could exploit his fitness advantage and front-running style to get first run. His recent Sandown win shows he has the speed to kick clear when the pace slackens.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders go suicidally fast and collapse together
scenarios.body: Bay Of Brilliance could emerge from the wreckage despite his long absence, using his prominent style to pick up the pieces. This would need an extreme pace scenario to unfold for the outsiders to capitalize.

watchPoints.text: Maho Bay's ability to cope with pressure from other front-runners will determine if his unbeaten record continues
Isaac Newton's jumping of the market despite poor recent form could signal significant stable confidence from O'Brien
Early pace battle between the three leaders will be crucial - whoever settles best holds the key
Bay Of Brilliance's long absence makes him vulnerable despite his prominent running style suiting the likely pace
Ground conditions remain good to firm across the card, eliminating going concerns for all runners

races.name: William Hill Chartwell Fillies' Stakes (Group 3)

runners_data.name: La Brodeuse
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits if pace is genuine, but 181 days off needs factoring despite Tom Marquand's booking

runners_data.name: Mandurah
runners_data.note: Non-runner status unclear, but prominent style would press early pace if participating
runners_data.comment: Good to firm suits; useful C&D form in Group 3 as a 2yo; new yard; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Winning 2yo debut was followed by a stout effort in a Group 3 over C&D (also good to firm) when leading from some way out and looked like holding on but couldn't quite sustain her effort; has rarely had her ground since but she ran well against an improver on AW (7f) in October on final start for the Crisfords; sold for 150,000gns; she might well have a good 4yo season.

runners_data.name: Havana Pusey
runners_data.note: Prominent runner likely to track Copacabana Sands, form solid with recent 11-day turnaround

runners_data.name: Fouette
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent recent form, benefits from any pace injection in middle sections

runners_data.name: Dash Of Azure
runners_data.note: High-class hold-up performer returning from 202-day break, strong finishing kick if race sets up right

runners_data.name: Copacabana Sands
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with Ryan Moore, likely pace-setter who should get comfortable fractions

runners_data.name: Royal Velvet
runners_data.note: Versatile hold-up horse in good current form, William Buick booking suggests confidence

runners_data.name: Sunlit Uplands
runners_data.note: Hold-up style fits race shape, but 170-day absence and moderate recent form are concerns

races.paceDynamic: Copacabana Sands appears the most natural pace-setter with front-running tendencies and Ryan Moore aboard, likely to dictate terms from the rail. Mandurah (if declared) and Havana Pusey could press early but both have shown willingness to settle just behind. With limited early speed in this field, Copacabana Sands should get comfortable fractions without serious pressure through the middle sections. This controlled tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish, particularly those with tactical speed like Dash Of Azure and Royal Velvet.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Copacabana Sands leads unchallenged through easy fractions
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get ideal positioning to unleash finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. Those with tactical speed and strong closing ability capitalise on the moderate gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Havana Pusey or prominent runners press Copacabana Sands early
scenarios.body: The tempo increases sufficiently to stretch the field and favour horses with sustained speed from prominent positions. Those positioned just off the pace can pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Special
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where the fastest finisher wins regardless of position. Raw finishing speed trumps tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Copacabana Sands gets perfect fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The leader maintains enough in reserve to repel all challengers despite the controlled early pace. Class and tactical positioning from the front proves decisive.

watchPoints.text: Copacabana Sands for early positioning - if pressed hard early, the whole race dynamic changes significantly
Royal Velvet's early positioning with William Buick - tactical speed could see her closer than usual hold-up spot
Dash Of Azure's fitness after 202 days off - any signs of rustiness could compromise finishing kick
Havana Pusey's aggressive tactics - likely to set or press pace which determines tempo for closers
La Brodeuse's sharpness returning from 181-day layoff - needs to be wound up first time back

races.name: William Hill Each Way Extra Handicap

runners_data.name: Back In Black
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with strong recent form but faces traffic issues in small field with patient tactics

runners_data.name: Mr Swivell
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning after 224-day break but trainer's 16% strike rate and good course record suggest readiness

runners_data.name: Apotheosis
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with headgear applied, likely to press the pace and challenge Mr Swivell early

runners_data.name: Christian David
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with back-to-back wins, benefits if early pace is strong but needs racing room

runners_data.name: The Dragon King
runners_data.note: Patient type dropping down in grade, must overcome tendency to need strong pace to be effective

runners_data.name: Dragon Leader
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form who could provide pace pressure, only 23 days since last run keeps her sharp

runners_data.name: Sword
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 204-day absence with headgear applied, needs everything to fall right

runners_data.name: Foreseen
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer at bottom of weights but recent form suggests he needs more pace than likely here

races.paceDynamic: Mr Swivell will likely lead from the gates with his prominent style and confirmed front-running tendency, setting a sustainable tempo without early pressure from fellow prominent runners Apotheosis and Dragon Leader who should settle just behind. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Back In Black, Christian David, The Dragon King, Sword, Foreseen) will track in behind, creating a patient early gallop before quickening from 2f out. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable late traffic problems that will plague the hold-up brigade in a small 8-runner field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Swivell leads uncontested and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setter controls the tempo throughout and kicks clear when the field comes to him, making it difficult for hold-up horses to close the gap effectively. His 224-day break becomes irrelevant as tactical positioning trumps fitness concerns.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Apotheosis and Dragon Leader press Mr Swivell early
scenarios.body: The prominent trio engage in pace pressure that sets up the race for late closers, with the early leaders weakening in the final furlong. Hold-up horses get the strong pace they need to showcase their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get blocked behind the slow early pace
scenarios.body: Multiple runners come with late runs simultaneously but get impeded in the straight, allowing a prominent runner who stayed out of trouble to capitalise. Racing room becomes the decisive factor rather than pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Swivell stops quickly after his long layoff
scenarios.body: The early leader's stamina gives way dramatically in the final 2f, creating a cavalry charge finish where the strongest stayer prevails. Fresh legs and recent race fitness become crucial advantages.

watchPoints.text: Mr Swivell's jumping and early pace-setting after 224 days off - any hesitation or sluggish start changes the entire complexion
Traffic problems developing 2f out when multiple hold-up horses (Back In Black, Christian David, The Dragon King, Sword) all need racing room simultaneously
Apotheosis and Dragon Leader's early positioning - if they press Mr Swivell too hard it sets up back-markers perfectly
Christian David and Back In Black getting clear runs in straight as both need unimpeded passages to show their true ability
The pace through the first 4f - anything slower than steady tempo heavily favours the patient brigade over front-runners

races.name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap

runners_data.name: Oracle Mission
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent 7f form on this surface, 152-day break is a concern despite winning on return before

runners_data.name: Mr Writer
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer but yet to win in 11 starts, Muscutt booking suggests connections confident

runners_data.name: Dagger Strike
runners_data.note: Strong prominent record at this trip with Doyle's 13% strike-rate, excellent recent 7f form on turf

runners_data.name: Hardy's Hero
runners_data.note: Classy hold-up performer whose recent 2nd suggests return to form, Marquand/Haggas 28% combination

runners_data.name: Fresh Fade
runners_data.note: Long absence of 148 days major worry despite decent 5-6f pace, needs to prove stamina for 7f

runners_data.name: Mystic Moment
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner better over further but has place claims if pace sets up right

runners_data.name: French Affair
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with consistent place record, 7lb claimer Dobbs reduces effective weight

runners_data.name: Assaranca
runners_data.note: Lone leader gets uncontested lead but 7lb weight advantage helps, recent 3rd suggests return to form

races.paceDynamic: Assaranca is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the gates, likely setting a measured gallop without pressure from the prominent runners Oracle Mission, Mr Writer, Dagger Strike, Fresh Fade, and French Affair. The hold-up pair Hardy's Hero and Mystic Moment will rely on the race developing into a sprint finish. With five horses looking to sit prominent behind the uncontested leader, the pace should be honest but not searingly quick. This setup strongly favours the prominent runners who can track Assaranca's tempo and strike in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Assaranca sets a steady tempo and the prominent brigade get first run on him.
scenarios.body: The five prominent runners get the perfect trip tracking the leader before launching coordinated challenges from the 2f pole. Hardy's Hero and Mystic Moment are left with too much to do from the back as the race becomes tactical.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack go too early chasing Assaranca and tie up in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Hardy's Hero and Mystic Moment benefit from a strong pace that sets up their late kick perfectly. The Haggas runner especially thrives when allowed to come from off the pace with his superior class showing.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Assaranca Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If the leader gets soft fractions and kicks clear when the prominent runners hesitate.
scenarios.body: With his 7lb weight advantage and no pressure early, Assaranca builds an unassailable lead entering the straight. The prominent runners' hesitation to commit early proves costly as the leader finds enough to hold on.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Assaranca goes very slowly and turns this into a messy sprint from the 3f pole.
scenarios.body: The crawling pace leads to a bunched field and traffic problems that catch several fancied runners out. Form gets turned upside down as positioning and luck become paramount in a cavalry charge finish.

watchPoints.text: Assaranca must be watched for early pace - if he goes too slowly this becomes a sprint that suits different profiles entirely
Hardy's Hero's jumping from the stalls - needs to be away cleanly to get the prominent position that suits his hold-up style
Fresh Fade may struggle with the 148-day layoff showing early in the race, particularly over this longer 7f trip
Oracle Mission's fitness after 152 days off - any signs of greenness or ring-rustiness early could compromise his chance
The pace through the first 3f will determine everything - watch if the prominent pack pressures Assaranca or sits waiting

races.name: William Hill Price Boosts Every Day Handicap

runners_data.name: Maharajas Express
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with David Probert's 5f expertise, good recent form and handles the going well

runners_data.name: Shalaa Asker
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer with Tom Marquand, excellent similar-going record and solid recent form at the distance

runners_data.name: My Boy Harry
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with 9lb weight advantage but poor trainer form and stepping down from longer distances

runners_data.name: Tuscan Point
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong recent form including a 5f win, Pat Cosgrave booking adds confidence

runners_data.name: Birkenhead
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner whose recent form shows some life, 17 days since last run may aid freshness

runners_data.name: Faustus
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who lacks a recent win but has consistent place form and only 7 days since last outing

runners_data.name: Desert Champion
runners_data.note: Prominent type with known finishing issues, 9lb weight pull helps but fading tendency is concerning

runners_data.name: Harry Brown
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with Hollie Doyle booked, lightest weight but poor recent form over longer trips

runners_data.name: So Smart
runners_data.note: Front-runner with limited similar-going experience, needs to improve on recent efforts to be competitive

races.paceDynamic: Birkenhead and So Smart will engage early with their confirmed leading styles, creating an honest gallop from the gates. Faustus and Desert Champion will sit prominent just behind the leaders, while the majority of the field are hold-up horses who will rely on a strong finish. The sustained pace set by two willing leaders should create perfect conditions for the closers to unleash their kicks. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can capitalise on a solid early tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Birkenhead and So Smart maintain a strong early gallop
scenarios.body: The honest pace will perfectly set up the closers who can time their runs from off the speed. Maharajas Express, Shalaa Asker and Tuscan Point all possess the tactical speed to benefit from this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Faustus or Desert Champion can get perfect positioning behind the leaders
scenarios.body: They can pounce when the front two come back to them in the final furlong. Faustus has better finishing credentials while Desert Champion's fading tendency remains a concern.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Two Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes moderate allowing the leaders to conserve energy
scenarios.body: Birkenhead and So Smart could have enough left in the tank to hold off the closers. Birkenhead's recent form gives him a slight edge over So Smart who lacks similar-going experience.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast too early and capitulate dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery for whoever has anything left, potentially favouring those who get the most cover early. This scenario would suit those with the best recent form regardless of style.

watchPoints.text: Birkenhead and So Smart must both show early speed or the pace could collapse, creating chaotic finish conditions
Desert Champion typically fades in the final stages despite prominent positioning, making him a risky proposition
My Boy Harry drops back to 5f from longer trips with struggling connections, form may not translate to this sharp test
Maharajas Express has David Probert aboard who excels in 5f sprints and knows how to time a finish perfectly
Tuscan Point's recent 5f victory with strong RPR suggests he's found his ideal trip and conditions
